Get the family parameterization contract

Source: R/parameterizations.R
get_parameterization.Rd

Looks up family-specific scale meaning, links, and natural-scale transforms from inst/extdata/family-parameterizations.csv. Errors if the family has no row.

Usage

get_parameterization(family)

Arguments

family

Family name (character), e.g. "gaussian".

Value

A list with fields family, response_distribution, scale_parameter, scale_meaning, link_mu, link_sigma, variance_expression, natural_sd_ratio, natural_variance_ratio, notes.
